scope: Synthetic integration smoke tests, not a production-accuracy estimate
note: Two preliminary cases were retested after tightening language/category instructions and lexical retrieval. The three final representative cases are included below.

email.body: 请告诉我如何查看物流，谢谢。
email.subject: 如何查看物流

classification.summary: 客户询问如何查看物流信息。

draft.draft: 您好，您可以打开订单确认邮件中的物流查询链接，查看承运商更新的物流进度。如果找不到订单确认邮件，请通过原订单渠道联系客服。本回复未查询您的具体订单状态。

cases.expected_reply: 您好，您可以在订单确认邮件中打开物流查询链接，查看承运商更新的进度。如找不到该邮件，请通过原订单渠道联系客服。本回复未查询您的具体订单状态。

email.body: My parcel arrived damaged. What information should I provide to have this investigated?
email.subject: Damaged parcel

classification.summary: The customer reports that their parcel arrived damaged and asks what information is needed to investigate it.

draft.draft: I’m sorry your parcel arrived damaged. To help investigate, please keep the original packaging and take clear photos of the damage. Please also provide your order reference and a description of the issue through the original order channel. An agent will need to check the carrier records. Compensation, a replacement, or a specific resolution timeframe cannot be confirmed before verification.

email.body: 请告诉我如何查看物流。另外我要申请退款，需要准备什么信息？
email.subject: 物流查询与退款请求

classification.summary: 客户希望了解如何查询物流，并申请退款及咨询所需准备的信息。

draft.draft:
您好，关于物流查询，您可以打开订单确认邮件中的物流查询链接，查看承运商更新的进度。如果找不到该邮件，请通过原订单渠道联系客服。该回复未查询您的具体订单状态。

关于退款或取消申请，请通过原订单渠道提供订单编号和退款原因，以便客服人工核实订单与履约状态。核实完成前，无法确认退款是否获批、退款金额或到账日期。请勿提供密码、验证码或完整银行卡号。
